decision_reason: Both dictionary modes show a paired Uprobe-minus-USDT workload reduction with 95 percent bootstrap intervals excluding zero. The matrix covers the normal lifecycle only, so it does not yet authorize a production-default transport change.

provenance.workload_contract: Each verified shared-openat operation performs 1,500,000 deterministic CPU rounds after the syscall.

interpretation.result: USDT is faster than Uprobe for both dictionary modes on this host and workload.
interpretation.promotion_boundary: Keep Uprobe as the default until the detach, callback-suppression, capture-failure, exec, and terminal-drain lifecycle fixtures demonstrate equivalent outcomes under USDT.
interpretation.image_contract: The rootful benchmark image must compile #include <sys/sdt.h>; Ubuntu multiarch placement is supported. CMake rechecks the optional header after prior failed configurations.
interpretation.scope_limit: This is a normal-lifecycle workload result on one host and is not a general application slowdown estimate.
